scope: Repair found and reproduced during the owner-requested 2026-09-23 Day One review: Continue on a Day One save made after the first castle entry opened the castle without establishing the Canvas world, so the world ID stayed empty. The empty-world watchdog then resumed the Day One room every frame (rebuilding its hotspots, layers and cover each time) and the castle tick that mounts the room activity never ran, leaving the child in a dark, rebuilding room with no basket. The repair makes Continue establish the Canvas world first, exactly as the boss return already does, and makes the watchdog's Day One reorientation rebuild the world once when the world ID is empty instead of looping. The dev-only defect reached dev with 940e4f0e and 7f49f14e; master ff68f955 predates both. No save key, protected asset, voice line or other routing changes; the hall entry line that still plays when Continue lands in a later room is left for the Day One rebuild.
